headline: S255 hardened generator discovery contracts, made the full build-check suite Windows-safe, and locked play-next impressions to true viewport views.

items.title: Generator head contracts enforced
items.insight: Page generators now prove their own canonical/social/discovery metadata, so regenerated pages cannot silently lose share-card or search contracts.

items.title: Build-check runner shipped
items.insight: The full 164-step quality suite now runs on Windows without command-line length failure while preserving direct exit-code truth.

items.title: Task-board rotation moved into closeout
items.insight: Closeout now consolidates stale runway headings before commit, reducing phantom carry pressure without relying on session memory.

items.title: Play-next impression honesty gated
items.insight: The conversion denominator stays tied to true viewport exposure, preventing redesign decisions from being driven by engagement-trigger artifacts.

followUps: Generalize viewport-impression contracts to other CTA surfaces.
Persist build-check runner step timing/failure summaries for trendable gate health.
blockers: play-next and INP decisions wait for clean post-2026-07-02 field data.
